Each style holds its positive `prompt` and per-prompt `negative` (both consumed by run_conditioning.py). `default_styles` = the styles shipped/rendered by default. Each style also carries `descriptor` (the form description that goes into the ref prompt and the img2img prompt) and `form` (the bare form name). The three conditioning steps use different text: ref = descriptor + stages.cond_ref.ref_common; inpaint = prompt/negative; img2img = stages.cond_img2img.template formatted with form/descriptor.
